Segway Powersports Secures Class 2 One-Two Finish on SCORE Baja 1000 Debut

Nov 16, 2026, 01:47 ET

Share this article

SAN JOSÉ DEL CABO, Mexico, Nov. 16, 2026 /CNW/ -- Segway Powersports claimed first and second place in Class 2 on its SCORE Baja 1000 debut, with both race-prepared Super Villain UTVs reaching the finish. The result marks a milestone for Segway Powersports, turning its first appearance at the event into a class victory and a double podium.

Continue Reading

For Segway Factory Racing, bringing both entries home at the front of their class reflects the preparation behind the program. Over an extended race distance, success depended on managing pace, responding to changing conditions and keeping each vehicle running through the demands of endurance competition. Baja put the Super Villain's performance to a sustained test, where durability and consistency mattered as much as speed.

The result follows a season of racing and development for the Super Villain, including appearances at King of the Hammers, the Mint 400, the Silver State 300 and Vegas to Reno. Those events provided opportunities to evaluate the race vehicles in different environments and refine preparations for Baja. The Class 2 one-two finish adds an endurance racing milestone to the sport side-by-side's growing competition record and strengthens Segway Powersports' credentials on the international off-road stage.

About Segway Powersports

Segway is a global leader in micro-mobility, powersports, and consumer robotics, known for its innovation and user-focused products. Segway Powersports focuses specifically on the design and manufacturing of next-generation powersports vehicles, including all-terrain vehicles (ATVs) and side-by-side vehicles (SxS) for both utility and sport applications. As a high-tech enterprise, Segway Powersports integrates a superior supply chain with its own manufacturing capabilities, managing the full lifecycle of its products – from R&D and production to sales and after-sales service.
